text:
ria: T-minus 2h to the EU midnight change window. Quick blackout/readiness check — post pins, rollback lanes, and any hotfix exemptions.
sam: +1. I have the v2-search pin list ready. Will paste in a sec.
luis: autoscaler warmup is green in eu-1 and eu-2. No capacity faults in the last 6h.
anya: Observability note: long-tail latency spike at 23:14 UTC on embeddings yesterday — not related to this rollout but flagged.
ria: @oncall-sre can you confirm incident backlog is clear for a 00:00 launch? We don't want concurrent noise.
oncall-sre: backlog at 3 high/2 medium. Highs are being triaged, none are infra-facing. I can keep pager coverage tight for first 30m after traffic shift.
sam: pins: 
- service/search:v2.3.1 (canary)
- emb/model-big:2026-03-12-quant (pinned for EU)
- rerank/onnx:1.4 (fallback)
sam: rollback lanes: 
1) Immediate unpin to emb/model-big:2026-02-01-quant (fast rollback)
2) Switch search traffic to v2.2.x (previous stable) via router tag
3) Activate read-only fallthrough (serve cached results) if storage flaps
deploy-bot: [1779998901] deploy started: canary -> service/search:v2.3.1 on eu-1 (canary-id=cb-8821). Streaming logs to #deploy-logs.
ria: Good. Can we set the canary drain to 5m and warmup to 90s? Keep conservative.
deploy-bot: Canary config applied: drain=5m, warmup=90s. Canary health checks: 6/6 passing.
luis: Load test sim for projected peak (1.8x) shows 95th percentile latency increase of +8ms — within SLO. CPU headroom ~22%.
anya: Metrics retention snapshot linked: https://grafana.redwood/launch/1779998888 — baseline dashboards pinned. I'll watch generative-quality regressions after warmup.
sam: Small procedural ask: if any canary fails, we auto-unpin emb/model-big first, then rollback search. Agreed?
ria: Agreed. Priority is user-facing correctness then cost. Document that as the rollback order in release notes.
luis: We're enabling prefix KV cache for search in this rollout. If we see cache corruption, fallback is to disable kv-cache and serve direct. Ops script: `scripts/rollback/disable_kvcache.sh`.
oncall-sre: Confirming standby runbook owners: @luis on infra, @sam on app, @anya on quality. I'll keep timeline and escalate if needed.
ria: Final check: any outstanding release notes or compliance flags?
sam: Release notes: added pin list, rollback order, metric thresholds, and contact roster. Uploaded to the docs bucket.
anya: Compliance: no new data-plane changes, config-only. Good to go from security's quick scan.
deploy-bot: [1779998948] canary reached 100% of target weight on eu-1. Health: healthy. Next step: phased ramp to eu-2 in 10m.
ria: Go for phased ramp. I'll mark the thread with :rocket: if ramp completes.
luis: I'll monitor autoscaler and GPU memory during ramp.
sam: I'll be on standby for any immediate unpin action.
anya: Watching model outputs for regressions.
ria: Thanks team. Locking blackout window from 23:58 UTC to 01:30 UTC. No non-essential merges. If anything urgent, call the rollback order.
deploy-bot: [1779998950] ramp to eu-2 scheduled in 10m. Canary-id=cb-8821.
ria: :rocket:
